result.summary: Detected an incorrect active navigation state in the bottom tab bar and minor styling inconsistency on card action buttons.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted as active in the bottom navigation while the Home screen is displayed.
issues.suggestion: Set the Home tab as active to accurately reflect the current screen.

issues.description: Favorite icon styling is inconsistent across cards; one card has a circular backing while another does not.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent background container styling to all favorite heart icons.
